verbetes.glosa_atual: casaco de couro; veste de pele, do latim scortea.
secretários privados do soberano; secretarii, do grego σηκρητάριοι.
definicoes_originais: , read אִיסְקְרִיטָרְיֵי m. pl. (σηκρητάριοι, secretarii) the sovereign’s private secretaries (Asecretis, v. D. C. Gr. a. Lat. s. v.).
notas_originais: Y. Keth. XII, 35 b; Y. Kil. IX, 32 c איסקבטיריי (corr. acc.).

verbetes.glosa_atual: variante textual referente a jogo semelhante a xadrez; provável corrupção de אִיסְקוּדְרָא.
notas_originais: iskodâr; Koh. Ar.; v. אִיסְקוּנְדְּרֵי) courier. Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39 d top יהב תרתין וכ' he gave two pounds of pepper to a courier (to go to Tyre), and he (the courier) went up and found &c.

verbetes.glosa_atual: moeda denominada issar; pequena unidade monetária na tradição.
definicoes_originais: (contr. of איסהר, cmp. איסתירא, an adapt.
notas_originais: of assarius = as) As, a Roman coin, usu. 1/ 24 of a Denar (v. Zuckerm. Talm. Gew. p. 22 sq.), called א' האיטלקי Italian As. Kidd. I, 1; a. fr.—Y. ibid. I, 58 d הא' אחד מכ"ד וכ' the As is 1/ 24 of the silver Denar.—Trnsf. coin. Taan. 19 b מדלית א' because there was a scarcity of coin.— Pl. אִיסָרִין. Y. Maas. Sh. IV, 55 b top.— Chald. Kidd. 12 a איסורי read אִיסָרֵי. [Gen. R. s. 42 א' לשם אלסר the Assar received its name from Elasar (Gen. XIV,

verbetes.glosa_atual: voto de abstinência; promessa vinculante, literalmente laço.
definicoes_originais: prop. band, hence vow of abstinence, (cmp. איסור).
notas_originais: Y. Ned. I, beg. 36 c.— Pl. אִיסָּרֹות, אִיסָּרִין, אֱסָרִין. Ibid. אין לוקין על הא' the punishment of lashes is not applied for breaking vows. Y. Yeb. XIII, 13 d אסורות (corr. acc.). Y. Ned. I, 36 d top. [אֵיסָר prisoner, v. אֵיסוּר.] [Gen. R. s. 42 א' לשם אלסר bands (chains) forged for Elasar, v. preced.]
Targ. O. Num. XXX, 3 (Y. אִיסְרָא); a. e.— Pl. אֵיסָרִין, אֵיסָרֵי. Targ. O. Num. XXX, 5; a. e.—[Targ. Ps. II, 3 אֱסָרָתָא (some ed. אֵסָרוּ'), v. next w.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: molho; feixe; conjunto atado, especialmente de plantas ou cereais.
definicoes_originais: אִיסְרָא, אֵיסְרָא; אֵיסַרְתָּא f. bundle, bunch, sheaf.
notas_originais: Targ. Y. Num. XIX, 18. Targ. O. Gen. XXXVII, 7; a. e.— Pl. אֵיסָרָן, אֵיסָרָתָא. Ibid. (ed. also אֵסרא, אֵסרתא). אֱסָרָתָא Targ. Ps. II, 3 (some ed. אֵסָרוּ') chains; v. preced.

Pes. 111 b א' דמזוני וכ' (Ms. M. שדא, read שרא; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) the genius appointed over sustenance is named Cleanliness. Ib. א' דעניותא וכ' (in Ms. our w. omitted) the genius of want is named Filth. Yoma 77 a א' דפרסי Ms. M. (ed. שרא, in a passage omitted in many editions, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) the genius of the Persians (Pharsees).

verbetes.glosa_atual: rua; via pavimentada, do latim strata.
estrada; caminho; forma feminina do anterior.
notas_originais: f. same. Y. B. Bath. VIII, 16 c top אינה היא א' that is not the proper way (= לא זו הדרך), i.e. it is inconsistent that the same formula should be illegal in the case of a letter of divorce, and legal in the case of a donation. Y. Gitt. VII, 48 d אינה איסרתה (corr. acc., and supplement acc. to Y. B. Bath. l. c.).

verbetes.glosa_atual: leitura a corrigir para דָּאנִיסְטִיסֵי; ver דָּנִיסְטֵיס.
notas_originais: , Y. B. Mets. II, 8 c מאילין דא', read דָּאנִיסְטִיסֵי, v. דָּנִיסְטֵיס

verbetes.glosa_atual: bando; grupo; contingente de homens; do grego στρατός.
definicoes_originais: (= אסטרטין, pl. of στρατός) band or body of men.
notas_originais: Gen. R. s. 87 א' של נואפים (Ar. אסרטיון) bands of adulterers; א' של רוצחים bands of murderers; (Yalk. Gen. 145 איסטר').

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver אִיסְרָטָה, forma feminina de estrada.
notas_originais: Y. Gitt. VII, 48 d, v. אִיסְרָטָה

verbetes.glosa_atual: tornozelo; passo; região de articulação do pé.
definicoes_originais: (Ithpe. or Ispe. of סְוַר = שָׁוַר to leap, stride; b. h. אֲשׁוּר; cmp. אִסְפֶּירֶס) ankle, foot-step.
notas_originais: Targ. Job XXIII, 11; a. e. Yeb. 103 a; Arakh. 19 b האי אי' עד ארעא נחית (Ar. אסתוו') what is called ist’vira ( ankle, in an anatomical sense) goes down to the ground (the entire length of the foot from the ankle). Men. 33 a, דעבידא כי אי' a door turning horizontally like the foot from the ankle.— Pl. אִיסְתְּוָורִין, רֵי … Targ. Koh. XII, 5; a. fr. Cmp. אֲתוּרֵי.

verbetes.glosa_atual: corrigir para סִיטֹונֵיסִין, comerciantes de cereal em passagem sobre dízimos.
definicoes_originais: Y. Maas. Sh. V, 56 b top תלת' א' וכ', read תלתא סִיטֹונֵיסִין (pl. of σιτώνης) three corn-dealers upon whose estimates he redeemed the second tithes.

verbetes.glosa_atual: moeda de prata; valor variável correspondente a sela provincial ou fração de zuz.
definicoes_originais: (contr. of אסתהרא &c., r. סהר, צהר; cmp. אִסְתַּהַר a. אִיסָר)
a silver coin, (with זוזא or פשיטא, or sub. זוזא &c.) equal to a common (provincial) Sela, or half a Zuz.
notas_originais: Keth. 64 a; Gitt. 45 b, v. טרפעיקא. B. Mets. 102 b. Bekh. 49 b א' סורסיא Syriac Istira (v. Zuckerm. Talm. Münz. p. 27). Kidd. 11 b.— Pl. אִיסְתִּירֵי Gitt. 14 a א' זוזי. Ḥull. 44 b א' פשיטי.—Ib. 105 a.

Tosef. Shek. II, 4 א' של זהב (Var. אִיסְטְרָאֹות) gold coins ( staters). Y. ib. III, 47 c איצטלי (corr. acc.). [Targ. II Esth. II, 7 יונית אִיסְתֵּירָא, a gloss to ככב נגהא, v. אִסְתַּהַר, confounding our w. with ἀστήρ.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: delicado; sensível; suscetível; pessoa de constituição frágil.
notas_originais: סניס, Ithpe. איסת', Ispe. איסט'; cmp. אִיתְנִיס; cmp. אִשְׁתְּמֹודַע as to Ishtafel) of feeble health, delicate, fastidious in diet. Yoma III, 5 איסת' Ms. a. Ar. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l., note 10; Bab. ed. mostly איסט'). Pes. 108 a. Snh. 100 b (opp. דעתו יפה not choicy); a. fr.— Pl. אִיסְתְּנִיסִים &c. Gen. R. s. 11 Ar. (ed. איסט'). Lam. R. to IV, 2 סיה … (read … סִים).— Chald. Targ. Job VI, 7 ed. אסת' (Ms. אסט'). [Cmp. b. h. נָסַס, ch. נְסִיס.]
read איסטרט', v. אִסְטַרְטֵיג a. foll.
Sifra Sh’mini ch. VII, Par. 6, v. חֵיפָה II
Ex. R. s. 40 (play on אֵיפֹה Job XXXVIII, 4) הא' שלך וכ' where was thy predestined temper suspended? (on which limb of Adam’s head, hair &c.?, v. preceding passage ibid.). Ib. אֵיפָתְךָ.

verbetes.glosa_atual: efa; medida de capacidade para secos na tradição bíblica.
notas_originais: Sifré Deut. 294, both a small as well as a large Ephah קרויה א' is named Ephah.—Men. 45 b top אֵיפָתָן the Ephah belonging to the sacrifices; a. fr.— Pl. אֵיפֹות. Ibid.

verbetes.glosa_atual: texto corrompido; Jastrow propõe leitura referente ao palácio, triclinio e aposento.
notas_originais: , Pesik. R. s. 26, א' הינטין; ed. Lemb. אפוטונטריק לינטין, ed. Friedm. לינטין, read מִפַּלְטִין טְרִיקְלִין וְקִיטוֹן than the palace (with) triclinium and bed-chamber wherein I dwell.

verbetes.glosa_atual: boca; orifício; abertura, especialmente claraboia ou abertura superior.
notas_originais: Erub. 100 a דהוה סליק בא' Ms. M. (ed. והוה) (a palm-tree) which grew up through the impluvium. Kidd. 81 a. Ḥull. 51 a

verbetes.glosa_atual: pena imposta; sentença; sanção, do grego ἐπιτίμια.
definicoes_originais: (Mus.), איפומטא, איפומניטא, איפומג' &c. (read: אֶיפִּיטִימְיָא) m. pl. (ἐπιτίμια, τὰ) the imposed penalty, sentence.
notas_originais: Deut. R. s. 2; Yalk. Gen. 77; Ex. 167. [Mus. reads נקרית sing. fem. = ἐπιτιμία.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: forragem; ração; alimento fornecido a animal.
notas_originais: Pl. אֵיפוּסִין. Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXVIII, 52 איפוסֵיהֶן אין מתקנין … their feed is not prepared for them; (Ex. R. s. 24, in a passage otherwise miscopied, אפוטיקון).

verbetes.glosa_atual: designação eufemística artificial para o nome divino, substituindo אֱלֹהֵי.
definicoes_originais: ĕ fofé, a disguise of ĕ lohé (אֱלֹהֵי); cmp. אִשְׁקוּקָה, אֲלִיקִי.
notas_originais: Y. Ned. XI, 42 c top, how did you swear? He said, ‘I swore Efofé Yisrael’ (for, By the God of Israel), ‘I will not enter my house’. He replied, (you said) Efofe Yisrael, ולא עללת לביתיך (not עללה) and on that account you would not enter your house?

verbetes.glosa_atual: melodia tocada às éguas durante a cobertura; do grego ἱπποθόρος.
definicoes_originais: (ἱπποθόρος, sub. νόμος, שירת) a tune played to mares on being covered.
notas_originais: Cant. R. to I, 9 (being asked why they rushed into the water, the horses said) א' נעשית לכם בים (ed. איפתיסיס, איפתוסים, אפ' corr. acc.) a hippothoros is prepared for you in the Sea (a satire on Egyptian lasciviousness).
Gen. R. s. 14, beg.; a. e. V. אֵיטָא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: consulado romano; cargo de cônsul; por extensão, era ou data contada desde acontecimento político.
definicoes_originais: (ὑπατεία) prop. Roman consulship, consulate, in gen. era, dating from accession to government or an other important event.
notas_originais: Lev. R. s. 36 נמנה בא' של מלכים (Ahaz) was counted under the era of kings (under whom Isaiah prophesied). Num. R. beg. ואיזה א'—איזה יום what day, month, year and era (from the exodus from Egypt.). Pesik. Baḥod. p. 104 a היו מונין א' וכ' count ye a new era from my son’s redemption. Ib. Haḥod. p. 52 b sq. he wrote her marriage contract וכתב לה א' in which he stated the era of his government.

verbetes.glosa_atual: legado imperial; governador delegado; vice-rei, do grego ὑπατικός.
definicoes_originais: (incorr. איפוט', איפיט') m. (ὑπατικός) consularis, Emperor’s delegate, viceroy.
notas_originais: Mekh. B’shall. Amalek, 2, א' מבטל וכ' the Hypaticus annuls it over his (the Hegemon’s) hand (ignoring his authority).— Pl. אִיפָּטִיקִין. Tanḥ. (ed. Bub.), Vayesheb 2 אפסיקין (corr. acc., v. note 4). V. היפטיקוס.
Bekh. 5 a, a. fr. אנן א' מתנינן לה our version is the reverse. Ḥull. 20 b, a. fr. אדרבא א' מסתברא, v. אַדְּרַבָּא. R. Hash. 20 a; a. v. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: pastilhas; pequenos comprimidos ou confeitos de açúcar, do latim pastilli.
definicoes_originais: (אֲפִיצְטְלִין Mus.) m. pl. (pastilli) lozenges, pills of sugar.
notas_originais: Cant. R. to I, 2. V. פִּיצְטְלִין, פּסְטילֹוס; cmp. Yalk. Cant. 981.
Zeb. 116 b I. Ormuzd, mother of king Shapur; B. Bath. 8 a bot; Taan. 24 b; Nid. 20 b אפ'.

verbetes.glosa_atual: passagem corrompida sobre pagamento ao escriba; leitura proposta ligada a moedas e emolumentos.
notas_originais: , Midr. Sam. s. 5 א' משלו היה read הפְּרוּטוֹת … היו (v. פְּרוּטָה, esp. Pes. 50 b) he (Nebucadnezar) had to pay the writer’s fees (for the change of בר אלהין into מלאכיה Dan. III, 25; 28), i.e. had to suffer for it; v. אִימּוּס. Cant. R. to VII, 9 פריטין משלו היו read פרוטין.

verbetes.glosa_atual: prefeito; governador provincial ou municipal; delegado administrativo, do grego ὕπαρχος.
definicoes_originais: (ὕπαρχος, ἔπαρχος) prefect of a province or town; governor, lieutenant.
notas_originais: Gen. R. s. 11; a. v. fr.— Pl. אִיפַּרְכִין, אִפַּ'; אִפַּרְכֵי, אִיפַּרְכַיָּא. Targ. Y. Num. XI, 28. Targ. Esth. I, 3; a. e.—Shebu. 6 b; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: prefeitura; governo provincial; ver o verbete seguinte.
província; prefeitura; governo de cidade, do grego ἐπαρχία.
notas_originais: Gen. R. s. 39; a. fr. [In Targ. also אִיפַּרְכָיוּתָא.]— Pl. אִיפַּרְכִיֹּות, אִפַּ'. Gen. R. s. 89; a. e. [Targ. Lam. I, 1 אַפְרִיכְיָא, read אִיפַּרְכַיָּיא. Targ. Y. II, Deut. III, 11 אפרכיון, read בֵּי אֵרְכִיוָן.] [Midr. Sam. ch. VII, לא' (Var. לאפי), v. אַפַּנְטֵי.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: pessoa que teve bens tomados por autoridade romana para cobrança de impostos.
definicoes_originais: (Ithpe. denom. of פּוּרְסָן) he was taxed (by Roman officials), i.e. his property was seized for taxes.
notas_originais: Y. Kidd. III, 64 a top א' לוי Levy’s property &c.
Gitt. 69 b א' רטיבא וכ' (Ar. אִצָּא) green twigs with which the river is dammed in (figur. for diarrhœa stopped). Cmp. הוּצָא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: aperto; pressão; compressão; queda ou desvalorização do preço de mercado.
definicoes_originais: trnsf. depression, depreciation in the market; [oth.
notas_originais: Yeb. 121 b top, אגב איצצא מזקי (Ar. איצא) on account of the pressure (which the falling person exercises on the serpents in the pit) they injure him. Sabb. 144 b דאתי בתר איצצא Ar. (ed. איצצתא; Ms. M. אִיצִיצָא) (the juice) which oozes out of the grapes through the pressure of their non weight. M. Kat. 11 a salted fish made fit for immediate use אגב א' by squeezing (and washing) out the salt.— Pl. אִיצְצֵי. Ib. שיתין א' sixty times pressed and washed.

opin. deterioration of quality]. Keth. 100 b אע"ג דנפל ביה איצצתא (read דנפלא; Ar. דהוי ביה איצא, Rashi איצצא) though there is a risk of depreciation (on account of large supply for the festive season) [or of getting sour].

verbetes.glosa_atual: destruição; ruína; eufemismo depreciativo para teatro.
local arruinado; lugar de destruição; designação depreciativa de teatro.
definicoes_originais: f. (orig. m. pl., Ithp. of צדי q. v.; sub. שדה &c.)
cacophemism for theatre (a place of destruction).
notas_originais: Y. Erub. II, 22 b את רואה את הא' כילו וכ' you look upon the debris near Tiberias as &c. (cmp. אלסיס).—* Pl. איצְטַדִּינִין. B. Bath. 103 b א' מהו if the stones in the field are debris, how is it? [Comment. diff.]
[The prevailing versions are אצטרין, אסטרין q. v.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: em Tosefta Baba Qamma, corrigir para אצטבא ou אצטווא.
notas_originais: Tosef. B. Kam. VI, 28, read אצטבא or אצטווא.

definicoes_originais: (אֲצַר q. v.) what is pressed out, juice.
(אוק = עוק; cmp. Lat. ambire, b. h. סבב) stallion-goat, buck.
notas_originais: Sabb. 152 a א' שליפא וכ' Ar. (ed. עיקרא, עקירא, Ms. Oxf. עיקר, Ag. Hatt. עקר, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 40) a goat, if castrated, sells for eight &c. [V. Sachs Beitr. II, 131 sq.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: terra habitada; mundo povoado; do grego οἰκουμένη.
notas_originais: Koh. R. VI, 3 אוקו' (corr. acc.); Gen. R. s. 32 יקו' (corr. acc.) (play on y’kum Gen. VII, 4).

verbetes.glosa_atual: semelhança; retrato; imagem esculpida, do grego εἰκών.
notas_originais: Targ. Y. Gen. V, 3.— Pl. h. אִיקֹונִין, אִיקֹונֹות; ch. אִיקֹונַיָּא, אִיקֹונָתָא. Ex. R. s. 30 (של מלך) א' emperor’s statues; a. fr.—Y. Ab. Zar. III, beg. 42 b איקוניות, איקינות read אִיקֹונֹות. Ib. 42 c top; a. e. V. אִיקֹונִין. [Midr. Till. to Pss. XV, XVII, v. אִיקוֹנְיָא.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: administrador; intendente; escrivão municipal; do grego οἰκόνομος.
notas_originais: Y. B. Mets. IX, beg. 12 a. Y. B. Bath. IV, 14 c bot. איקומנוס (corr. acc.). B. Bath. 68 b אינקלמוס, אנקולמוס, אנקל', אונק' (popul. corrupt.).
Midr. Till. to Ps. XV (ref. to Is. XXXI, 9, applied to the Roman empire or emperor) ‘his rock’ זה א' this means the statues with the likenesses of the emperors (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Statuary).

verbetes.glosa_atual: procissão com imagens portáteis; cortejo com figuras.
definicoes_originais: (pl. as a collect. noun) (denom. of אִיקֹון) a procession in which portable images are carried.
notas_originais: Midr. Till. to Ps. XVII א' של מלאכים וכ' a procession of angels passes before man and they cry, Make room לאיקוניה של וכ' (read לְאִקֹונָיו or לְאִיקֹונֹות; Yalk. Ps. 670; Deut. R. s. 4 לאִיקֹונִין) for the images of the Lord (man being created in the image of God). Deut. R. l. c. או' מהלכת (corr. acc.).

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver אִיקֹונְיָא, referente a procissão de imagens.
imagem; pintura; retrato; representação ou traços do rosto, do grego εἰκόνιον.
definicoes_originais: (εἰκόνιον) picture, image; Targ. Y. Gen. IV, 5 features (pl.); a. fr.—Ex.
notas_originais: R. s. 15. Deut. R. s. 4, v. אִיקֹונְיָא II; a. fr.—Esp. זִיו א' the brightness of expression, features.—Gen. R. s. 53; a. fr.—Ex. R. s. 35 א' נאה (sub. זיו) fine appearance; Cant. R. to III, 11 אותונין (corr. acc.).— Pl. v. אִיקֹון
, Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41 d, read with some ed. איקרין, v. אִיקָר

verbetes.glosa_atual: forma reflexiva de קְלַס; remissão morfológica.
